confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Japanese regional-city restaurant prices are reasonably well known, but hotel and hostel anchors are less certain (roughly ±25%). The FX value comes from a search-result snippet of the RBA exchange-rates overview page dated 2026-10-15; I did not open the page. Other snippets showed 0.7002 (14 Oct) and 0.6979 (9 Oct), so verify 0.6955 against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Japanese regional cities such as Takamatsu and Okayama, with prices somewhat below Osaka and Tokyo. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the restaurant meal level; wine is less common in Japanese casual restaurants, so that anchor is the least certain of the drink figures.
